# Eval-verb acquisition {#sec-eval-verbs} ::: {.callout-important} ## AI-generated — not for publication The code and prose in this book were written by an AI agent under human direction; not line-by-line verified; must not be published or cited as-is. ::: ::: {.callout-warning} ## Preliminary & unvetted analysis Exploratory analyses of preliminary work; numbers not independently validated; check before use. ::: Same filled CHILDES sample as [acquisition curves](#sec-curves) (61 corpora, 962 children), restricted to the [eval-set](#sec-eval) verbs: 10 VL, 8 VOL, 10 VO, 6 VOO. Token CDFs are inverse-weighted by all child tokens per 3-month bin. First-production ages use delayed-entry Kaplan–Meier (left-censor at first child-speech session; never-producers right-censored at last session). The construction-level panel pools eval verbs: a child attains the construction at the first of those verbs, with the same censoring, and each 3-month hazard is events / children still at risk. ## Sampling-adjusted CDFs Each 3-month bin is weighted by this verb's tokens divided by all child tokens (any word) in that bin, then accumulated and renormalized to 100%. Y-axis is cumulative weighted share (%). ::: {#cell-fig-eval-cdf .cell fig-height='8' execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 8), sharex=True, sharey=True) for ax, vac in zip(axes.ravel(), VACS): order = ORDER.loc[ORDER.vac.eq(vac)].sort_values("n_tokens", ascending=False) sub = CURVES.loc[CURVES.vac.eq(vac)] for verb in order.verb: row = sub.loc[sub.verb.eq(verb)].sort_values("age_months") if row.empty: continue ax.plot(row.age_months, row.cumulative_share * 100, label=verb) ax.set_title(TITLES[vac]) ax.set_xlim(12, 69) ax.set_ylim(0, 100) ax.set_xticks([12, 24, 36, 48, 60]) ax.legend(fontsize=8, loc="lower right", frameon=False, ncol=2) axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("Cumulative weighted share (%)") axes[1, 0].set_ylabel("Cumulative weighted share (%)") axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Age (months)") axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Age (months)") fig.tight_layout() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Sampling-adjusted cumulative token share by child age for eval-set verbs in each schematic VAC.](03-eval-verbs_files/figure-html/fig-eval-cdf-output-1.png){#fig-eval-cdf width=1186 height=947} ::: ::: ## First production by child, left-truncated and right-censored Each small dot is one child's first observed use of that verb+construction. Children enter the risk set at their first recorded child-speech session. A first use in that first session is left-censored and counted at entry. Children who never produced the combination are right-censored at their last parsed child-speech session and are not plotted as dots. The large marker is the Kaplan–Meier median age of acquisition; whiskers are a 95% bootstrap CI. If the KM curve never falls to 50%, a dashed arrow shows the lower bound (if any). ::: {#cell-fig-eval-km .cell fig-height='10' execution_count=4} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(10, 10), sharex=True) for ax, vac in zip(axes.ravel(), VACS): plot_km(ax, vac) axes[1, 0].set_xlabel("Age (months)") axes[1, 1].set_xlabel("Age (months)") fig.tight_layout() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![First observed production age (dots) for eval-set verbs, with Kaplan–Meier median and 95% bootstrap CI. Verbs ordered by earliest KM median. Delayed-entry KM; never-producers right-censored.](03-eval-verbs_files/figure-html/fig-eval-km-output-1.png){#fig-eval-km width=1185 height=1187} ::: ::: ## Construction-level first production One curve per schematic VAC. The event is a child's first production of **any** eval-set verb in that construction. Delayed entry at first child-speech session; left-censor if that first use is in the first session; right-censor never-producers at last session. On each 3-month bin the hazard is $n_{\mathrm{event}} / n_{\mathrm{risk}}$ (inverse-weighted by how many children are still at risk at that age). The plotted CDF is $F(t) = 1 - S(t)$. Curves need not reach 1: some children never produce an eval verb in that frame while observed. ::: {#cell-fig-eval-vac-cdf .cell fig-height='4.5' execution_count=5} ``` {.python .cell-code} fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5)) for vac in VACS: row = VAC_CDF.loc[VAC_CDF.vac.eq(vac)].sort_values("age_months") ax.plot(row.age_months, row.cdf * 100, label=TITLES[vac]) ax.set_xlim(12, 69) ax.set_ylim(0, 100) ax.set_xticks([12, 24, 36, 48, 60]) ax.set_xlabel("Age (months)") ax.set_ylabel("Children with first production (%)") ax.legend(frameon=False, loc="lower right") fig.tight_layout() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display} ![Discrete Kaplan–Meier CDF of age at first production of any eval-set verb, one curve per construction. Bin hazard = events / children at risk.](03-eval-verbs_files/figure-html/fig-eval-vac-cdf-output-1.png){#fig-eval-vac-cdf width=946 height=527} ::: ::: ::: {#tbl-vac-cdf .cell execution_count=6} ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=28} ```{=html}
